shots.image_prompt: {HERO} stands in a sunny orchard garden with green grass and fruit trees in soft focus behind him, full body, centered, nose lifted, sniffing the air with eyes half closed and a curious, delighted smile. {STYLE}
shots.prompt_en: The little orange fox cub lifts his nose and sniffs the air curiously, then opens his eyes wide with a delighted smile, ears perking up, tail wagging. Static camera. Soft breeze and birdsong, no speech, no music.

shots.prompt_en: The little orange fox cub jumps up and down happily on the spot with arms raised, laughing, tail swishing. Static camera. Light cheerful orchard ambience, no speech, no music.
